expedition.name: Expedition
expedition.question: Stay for one more reward, or return with what I have?
expedition.exists: Movement, combat, loot pickup, equipment and XP.
expedition.gap: A player-facing goal, preparation, a reason to return, and a next destination.
expedition.minimum: One tavern → road → enemy pocket → useful reward → tavern circuit.

economy.name: Economy and resupply
economy.priority: First · make loot and gold useful
economy.question: Keep this drop, sell it, or spend gold on the next trip?
economy.exists: Numeric gold payouts and item ownership.
economy.gap: Connected buying/selling, authored prices and recurring useful purchases.
economy.minimum: One supply NPC: sell surplus, buy food and pay for safe recovery.

production.name: Supply production
production.priority: Next · add one useful noncombat activity
production.question: Make supplies myself, or buy them and head out sooner?
production.exists: Materials and food in the catalog; farm and river geography.
production.gap: Interactable resource, recipe, station and a useful consumption action.
production.minimum: One ingredient → one preparation station → one meal. No new skill roster required.

discovery.name: Discovery and access
discovery.question: Follow the known road, or investigate that side path?
discovery.exists: Connected road, woodland, farm, tavern and outskirts scenery.
discovery.gap: Discoveries with a payoff, access conditions and remembered unlocks.
discovery.minimum: One side path or cache plus one earned shortcut; preserve the calm open landscape.

mastery.name: Combat mastery
mastery.priority: Next · make existing combat ask better questions
mastery.question: Which style, position or target order solves this encounter?
mastery.exists: Attack styles, resistances, ranged/hybrid behavior, cover collision, wall and knockback spells.
mastery.gap: Authored encounters and readable cues that reward those tools.
mastery.minimum: One melee threat and one ranged threat where cover and target order matter. Keep agreed spell roles.

collection.name: Collection and long goals
collection.priority: Later · give repeated trips a destination
collection.question: Which enemy or route gets me the piece I still need?
collection.exists: Tiered equipment and an agreed direction to spread higher-tier sets across creatures.
collection.gap: Player-facing reward sources, collection tracking and meaningful milestone payoffs.
collection.minimum: One visible equipment goal with known sources; reliable early progress alongside rare prizes.
